journal.title: OWNER OVERRIDE: risk per trade raised to 5% (was 0.5%)
journal.detail: Tony chose this explicitly after being warned. Sizing still uses the worst allowed fill (IOC limit vs stop). Total open-risk cap raised to 5% (was 3%), so effectively one full-risk position at a time. Margin cap: 10% base, raised per trade only as needed (max 60% of account equity); if a 5% trade needs more margin (10x coins at a tight stop), its size is reduced to fit, so actual risk is then below 5%. Unchanged: leverage max 40x and each coin max, stop on every trade, liquidation >= 1.5x stop distance, -3% day stop, -20% kill switch vs 37.93, min notional 10 USD. journal.title: Coexistence with HST on the same master account
journal.detail: Owner decision: HST trades coins outside our list (BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE, kPEPE, ZEC, BNB) on the same account, isolated margin, cloid prefix 0x485354. Our bot now: (1) never closes, cancels or modifies positions/orders on non-list coins or any order with an HST cloid (blocked attempts are logged as refused); new orders carry our cloid prefix 0x414c50 (ALP); (2) day stop -3% and kill switch -20% use OUR OWN equity = 37.89549 USDC anchor (2026-10-19 00:59:30 UTC, flat) + our realized PnL - fees + funding on our coins + our uPnL; kill switch flattens only our positions; (3) trades are sized from min(own equity, account equity minus HST margin); 0.5% risk cap unchanged; the 10% margin cap counts TOTAL account margin (ours + HST), so HST margin can block our entries; (4) if total account equity falls 20% below 37.93 for any reason, no new entries, existing positions still managed, HST never closed. Dashboard shows our stats separately and HST positions as external (HST), read-only.

journal.title: Fixed equity double-count in unified account
journal.detail: On a unified account the spot USDC total already includes perp uPnL; the bot added uPnL again, so equity looked higher when winning and lower when losing (affects day stop and sizing slightly). Now account equity = spot USDC total. Own-equity calculation reconciles exactly with account equity while HST is not trading (37.7036 = 37.7036).

journal.title: Evolution cadence: every 2h (or after 15 new live signals)
journal.detail: Owner decision: rounds every 2h instead of 6h; a burst of 15 new live signals can trigger a round sooner (at least 30 min apart). Still one parameter per round, same promotion rules, hard limits untouched. New anti-overfitting guards: (1) held-out slice: on the last 90 days the variant must match or beat the current version on PF and expectancy, with at least 20 trades; (2) walk-forward: 12 months split into 4 quarters; the variant must match or beat current expectancy in 3 of 4; (3) identical variants (same full parameter set) are never re-tested; (4) live re-check: after 15 closed live trades on a promoted version, if live mean R is more than 0.25R below its backtest expectancy, auto-rollback to the parent version. Next round due 02:44 UTC.

journal.title: Ops: bot frozen while SOL trade ran; runner stopped at the original stop

journal.title: Coin set expanded: BTC, ETH + HYPE, SOL, kPEPE, ZEC, BNB (owner decision)
journal.detail: Owner Tony chose to add HYPE, SOL, kPEPE (Hyperliquid 1000-PEPE contract), ZEC and BNB to the live 15m trend-pullback bot to raise signal frequency (more data for the Evolution loop). Same formula and evolution rules; evolve.py now scores every variant on the full 7-coin portfolio. Exchange limits (Hyperliquid meta): BTC 40x szDec 5; ETH 25x szDec 4; SOL 20x szDec 2; HYPE 10x szDec 2; kPEPE 10x szDec 0; ZEC 10x szDec 2; BNB 10x szDec 3; min order $10 notional on all. Coins under 20x (HYPE, kPEPE, ZEC, BNB) trade at their 10x max only when estimated liquidation is >= 1.5x the stop distance, otherwise the trade is skipped. Hard limits unchanged: 0.5% risk/trade, stop on every trade, -3%/day stop, -20% kill switch, no new trade while one is losing, margin <= 10% of equity, 07-21 UTC entries, news filter, skip if $10 minimum cannot be met within risk. At ~$37.9 equity a 10x-coin trade with the 0.5% minimum stop uses the whole 10% margin cap, so in practice one position at a time.
